books.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Old Tom was the keeper of the lighthouse on Grey Rock. Every evening he climbed the winding stairs to light the great lamp.
The lamp's light swept across the dark sea, guiding ships safely home. Tom was proud of his job.
One wild winter night, a terrible storm blew in. The wind howled, and the waves crashed against the rocks.
Tom's lamp flickered and went out! He worked quickly, his hands shaking, until at last the light shone again.
Down below, a fishing boat saw the light just in time and turned away from the rocks. The crew waved up at the lighthouse.
Tom smiled as the storm passed. A lighthouse keeper's light is small, but on a dark night it can save a whole crew.

books.title: The Winter Wolf
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: High in the snowy mountains lived a young wolf called Ash. He was the smallest wolf in his pack.
When winter came, food was hard to find. The pack searched for days, but the snow was deep and the deer were far away.
Ash remembered a valley he had found in the summer, where the snow was shallow and rabbits hid under the bushes.
He led the pack through the forest and over the frozen stream to the valley. There, under the bushes, were rabbits.
The pack ate well that night, and the old wolf said, 'Ash, you may be small, but you have a sharp mind and a brave heart.'
From that winter on, Ash was the pack's scout. He always remembered the hidden places, and the pack never went hungry again.

books.title: The Garden of Giants
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Behind the school was a walled garden that nobody ever entered. The children said giants lived there.
One spring, the new teacher, Miss Rose, found the key and opened the rusty gate. The children followed her inside.
The garden was wild and wonderful. Sunflowers taller than the children grew beside pumpkins as big as chairs.
Miss Rose said, 'This garden needs friends.' So the children pulled weeds, watered the plants, and planted new seeds.
By summer the garden was full of vegetables and flowers. The children shared the harvest with the whole school.
Nobody calls it the garden of giants any more. Now it is the school garden, and every child helps it grow.

books.title: The Snowy Mountain
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Emma lived at the foot of a tall, snowy mountain. Every winter she watched the mountain shine white in the sun, and she dreamed of climbing to the top.
One spring morning, Emma packed her bag with food, water, and a warm coat. Her friend Leo came with her, and together they began the long climb.
The path was steep and rocky, and the wind was cold. Emma's legs were tired, but she kept going, one step at a time.
At last, they reached the top. From there they could see the whole valley below, with rivers, forests, and tiny houses in the distance.
Emma and Leo sat down and ate their lunch in the sunshine. Emma smiled and said, "We did it!" It was the best day of her life.
